description: Search companies listed in Orbtown. All given filters apply together (AND). Free text matches company or project name, website, trade, services, city, country and description, ignoring case and accents; exact name matches rank first. Returns name, services, website, address, country, profile link, total and a relevance score. Page with offset.

category.description: Trade id or trade name in English, German, Czech, Slovak or Polish, or part of it, e.g. "acc", "Accounting & tax", "dentist"

city.description: City or part of the address, as the company wrote it, e.g. "Split"

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, e.g. "AT" or "Austria"

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging

query.description: Free text: company or project name, website, trade or service, optionally with a city, e.g. "Limontera", "hopa.hr" or "Zahnarzt Graz"

name: search_businesses
